cyclic:waxed_redstone.tooltip: Redstone Block limited to one facing side
cyclic:waxed_redstone.guide: Uses max 15 redstone power similar to a Redstone block. Facing state based on where you face when item is used. Only one face of the block is powered
cyclic:spark.guide: Use where there is an air space to place invisible light sources. Places the block minecraft:light. Remove a light by using a spark on it
cyclic:button_blackstone.guide: Blackstone Button has power level of 8
cyclic:button_basalt.guide: Basalt Button has power level of 4
cyclic:gold_soul_lantern.guide: Gold Soul Lantern has light level 15
cyclic:copper_pressure_plate.guide: Copper Pressure Plate produces redstone signal when stepped on
cyclic:netherite_pressure_plate.guide: Netherite Pressure Plate produces redstone signal when stepped on
cyclic:obsidian_pressure_plate.guide: Obsidian Pressure Plate produces redstone signal when players step on it
cyclic:flint_block.guide: Crafting material compressed from nine flint
cyclic:compressed_cobblestone.tooltip: Crafting material compressed from nine cobblestone
cyclic:compressed_cobblestone.guide: Crafting material compressed from nine cobblestone
cyclic:lunchbox.guide: Fill with edible items and it will let you eat them in order left to right.  Crouch to open inventory
cyclic:milk_bottle.tooltip: All the benefits of Milk in a smaller package
cyclic:milk_bottle.guide: Applies the milk curative effect to the player, removing most harmful effects
cyclic:fireball.guide: Throwable like a fire charge.  Crafting ingredient
cyclic:fireball_dark.guide: Throwable like a fire charge.  Crafting ingredient
cyclic:shield_wood.guide: Gets destroyed in a single hit from explosions. Config sets this as weaker than regular shields.
cyclic:shield_leather.guide: This shield when used takes no durability damage from explosions.  Config sets this as weaker than regular shields.
cyclic:shield_flint.tooltip: A slightly weaker shield that can reflect damage
cyclic:shield_flint.guide: 50% chance to take no durability damage from arrows.  25% chance to reflect projectile attacks with one point of thorns damage to the attacker.  Config sets this as weaker than regular shields.
cyclic:shield_obsidian.guide: Prevents knockback completely while blocking.  Takes no durability damage from projectiles or explosions (unless they bypass armor)
cyclic:shield_bone.guide: Takes no durability tamage from projectiles.  Not weaker than normal shields unlike some others
cyclic:flute_summoning.tooltip: Tap on a specific entity to summon it later
cyclic:flute_summoning.guide: Saves the ID of a target entity on use.  Then if you use it later it will attempt to summon the entity to you, if the dimensions match
cyclic:altar_destruction.guide: Cancel damage and desturction of nearby explosions
cyclic:glass_connected.guide: Connected textures, similar to compressed glass
cyclic:no_soliciting.tooltip: Prevent spawns of some harmless annoying creatures
cyclic:no_soliciting.guide: Nearby natural spawns of the specified mob types (bats, traders, trader llamas) will not spawn.  Only runs when blockstate is lit, interact to disable.
cyclic:sponge_lava.tooltip: Eats up nearby lava source blocks
cyclic:sponge_lava.guide: Place and wait for some time to let it soak up nearby lava.  Source lava is not recoverable, it is deleted by the sponge
cyclic:sponge_milk.tooltip: When placed it clears all potions from nearby entities
cyclic:sponge_milk.guide: When placed it will clear potions from creatures and players in the area.  Break and replace to trigger again
cyclic:teleport.guide: Place and feed with energy.  Use a GPS Location device to track a target destination for the teleport.  Crouch to use
cyclic:crusher.tooltip: Grind up materials or break down components
cyclic:crusher.guide: Grinding recipes sometimes have a chance for a bonus extra product
cyclic:battery_clay.tooltip: Small energy storage holds up to 16k
cyclic:battery_clay.guide: Holds 16,000RF.  When powered with redstone this block will output power down if possible
cyclic:doorbell.guide: Light level 4 and redstone power of 1 while pressed.  Plays sound cyclic:doorbell_mikekoenig
cyclic:trash.tooltip: Deletes all items and fluids piped into it
cyclic:trash.guide: Deletes all items and fluids piped into it.
cyclic:trash.guide0: Warning! There's no undo button. Once the item's gone, it's gone.
cyclic:experience_pylon.tooltip: Collects XP from nearby orbs and players that crouch on it
cyclic:experience_pylon.guide: Use a bottle or empty hand to extract experience.  The Experience Pylon automatically collects nearby experience orbs and stores them as Fluid Experience in its internal buffer. Fluid Experience can be pumped into and out of the pylon.
cyclic:experience_food.guide: Created by using the Experience Pylon, and the Solidifier.  Eat the confection to gain the experience held within, or use it on an Experience Pylon to put experience back into the pylon.
cyclic:charm_stone.tooltip: Immune to suffocation & elytra crash damage
cyclic:charm_stone.guide: Prevents damage when elytra crashing into walls.  Also suffocation if you noClip or teleport into solid wall of blocks
cyclic:charm_attack_speed.guide: Increase attack speed.  This causes the recovery bar by the crosshairs to recover faster for increased damage overall.  Default is 50 percent increase, depends on config file.
cyclic:charm_luck.guide: Increase players passive luck attribute, which affects some loot tables such as mobs, fishing, treasure chests.  Default is 10 points, depends on config file
cyclic:charm_xp_blocker.guide: Blocks pickup of XP Orbs.  They are still attracted to and float around the player
cyclic:charm_xp_speed.tooltip: Pickup XP Orbs as fast as possible
cyclic:charm_xp_speed.guide: Pickup XP Orbs as fast as possible by removing the internal cooldown on pickup
cyclic:charm_knockback_resistance.guide: Immune to knockback; when you take damage the player will not be moved
cyclic:quiver_lightning.tooltip: Living targets have a 25% chance of retribution
cyclic:quiver_lightning.guide: When arrow hits a living target, randomly decides to summon a lightning bolt on the target
cyclic:quiver_damage.guide: Arrow damage increased while this is worn in inventory or curios.  Can be disabled with right click just like other baubles
cyclic:charm_venom.tooltip: Attacks have 25% chance to poison target
cyclic:charm_venom.guide: When damage dealt from the player as a source, this adds a chance to give the poison potion effect for a few seconds on the target
cyclic:charm_water.guide: Prevent drowning damage after air is empty
cyclic:charm_starvation.tooltip: Immune to damage and death by starvation
cyclic:charm_starvation.guide: Immune to damage and death by starvation
cyclic:charm_invisible.guide: Applies the invisibility potion effect like a beacon would
cyclic:charm_boostpotion.guide: Potion duration increased when consumed, while this is worn in inventory or curios.  Can be disabled with right click just like other baubles
cyclic:charm_magicdefense.guide: All magic that wearer takes is reduced while this is worn in inventory or curios.  Can be disabled with right click just like other baubles
cyclic:charm_stealthpotion.guide: Disables potion particles at the moment you gain the effect, or drink the potion.  Does not work on existing effects, so if you drink a potion and then equip it does not know
cyclic:charm_antipotion.guide: Potion duration is nullified at the time of consumption.  Treats positive and negative effects the same.  Ignores instant effects
cyclic:charm_longfall.guide: Immune to fall damage, and cactus and sweetberry damage
cyclic:crafting_stick.guide: Handheld crafting table.  Does not preserve its inventory
cyclic:crafting_bag.guide: Handheld crafting table with an inventory that is saved in itself like a backpack
cyclic:terra_glass.tooltip: Reactive to sunlight, promotes crop growth
cyclic:terra_glass.guide: Reacts to sunlight if it is in direct contact.  Produces light and lights up crops when in the sun.
cyclic:detector_weather.tooltip: Redstone output level depends on weather
cyclic:detector_weather.guide: Full power when thunderstorm, half power in the rain
cyclic:detector_moon.tooltip: Redstone output level depends on phase of the moon
cyclic:detector_moon.guide: The eight phases of the moon each output a different power level
cyclic:rotator.tooltip: Rotates targeted block when triggered with redstone
cyclic:rotator.guide: Triggers when redstone power goes from off to on.  Rotates common valid block states
cyclic:eye_teleport.tooltip: Look and crouch to teleport onto it
cyclic:eye_teleport.guide: Whenever a player is looking at this while crouching, the player is teleported on top of this block.  If solid blocks are above it, there is some leeway where you will appear above all of those blocks.  Same logic as Ender Scepter.  Can cost hunger and experience based on config values.
cyclic:ghost.guide: While this block has redstone power, it is not selectable or breakable, and all entities pass through it.  It is also completely invisible.  Remove the power to break it.
cyclic:ghost_phantom.guide: While this block has redstone power, it is not selectable or breakable, and all entities pass through it.  Remove the power to break it.
cyclic:hopper.guide: Moves items one per tick with similar logic to regular hoppers.  Is disabled with redstone.  Collects only from the area directly above the hopper
cyclic:hopper_gold.guide: Moves items 64 per tick with similar logic to regular hoppers.  Is disabled with redstone.  Collects only from the area directly above the hopper
cyclic:hopper_fluid.guide: Moves fluids one bucket per tick with similar logic to regular hoppers.  Is disabled with redstone.  Collects only from the area directly above the hopper
cyclic:eye_redstone.tooltip: Redstone powered while a player is looking
cyclic:eye_redstone.guide: This block detects nearby players, and checks their eye position to see if the player is looking at the block.  Whenever its being looked at, the blockstate is updated and it produces redstone power.
cyclic:collector.guide: The Collector picks up nearby items and stores them in its internal buffer. Items can be taken directly out of the buffer, or piped out.
cyclic:cask.guide: The Cask is a small tank for storing fluids.Fluids can be inserted and removed both by pipes and by buckets and other handheld fluid containers.
cyclic:flower_purple_tulip.guide: May spawn in the following biome Categories: river, savanna, underground, mesa, forest, mushroom
cyclic:flower_absalon_tulip.guide: May spawn in the following biome Categories: river, plains, taiga, underground, mesa, jungle
cyclic:flower_lime_carnation.guide: May spawn in the following biome Categories: river, beach, ocean, icy, extreme hills, jungle
cyclic:flower_cyan.guide: A lost legacy from a lost version of Minecraft.  Spawns alone in biome categories: forest, plains, taiga, extreme hills).
cyclic:apple_sprout.guide: Plant below a leaf block to grow an apple.
cyclic:apple_sprout_emerald.guide: Plant below a leaf block to grow an emerald apple.
cyclic:apple_sprout_diamond.guide: Plant below a leaf block to grow a diamond apple.
cyclic:apple_sprout_chocolate.guide: Plant below a leaf block to grow an apple.
cyclic:scythe_harvest.guide: Harvest the area on use.  Sneak to harvest a smaller area.  Uses the same logic as the Harvester block.
cyclic:location_data.tooltip: Saves the location of a block
cyclic:location_data.guide: Right click on a block with the GPS Marker in hand to save its position to the Marker.Markers with saved locations can be used in multiple machines from this mod such as Shape Builder .
cyclic:computer_shape.tooltip: Read buildings into a Shape Card
cyclic:computer_shape.guide: Place two  GPS Card cards and one  Shape Card, then you can read, copy, paste, and merge shapes together.
cyclic:entity_data.guide: Store data on an entity-type, such as minecraft:sheep and the data tags.  Used in: Fan, Pharos Beacon
cyclic:blockstate_data.tooltip: Use to remember target block or blockstate
cyclic:blockstate_data.guide: Use on a block to read and remember its block state.  Crouch while using to filter on the block only.  Can store a list of 18 blockstates.  Craft to erase the list.  It can distinguish between identical blocks in different states such as rotated stairs, double slabs, etc if in exact [blockstate] mode. Used for machine filters, See Miner
cyclic:filter_data.tooltip: Holds items and settings used for filters
cyclic:filter_data.guide: Fill with items to adjust machine or cable settings that are filtered
cyclic:shape_data.tooltip: Builds in-world after setup in a Shape Computer
cyclic:shape_data.guide: Place in a Shape Computer or a Shape Builder to load with data, then click on a block to load its block
cyclic:sound_data.tooltip: Use to play the recorded sound
cyclic:sound_data.guide: Record nearby sounds and play them later.  See matching machines for details
cyclic:sound_recorder.tooltip: Records sounds; save into Sound Data Cards
cyclic:sound_recorder.guide: Record any sounds up to 8 blocks away, and record in the block.  Comes with an ignore list that you can build up.  Save to Sound Data Card for use in Sound Player.
cyclic:lamp.tooltip: Light level depends on redstone input
cyclic:lamp.guide: Light level depends on how much redstone power is given.  Max power is max light, a weak redstone signal is almost no light
cyclic:membrane.tooltip: Walk on this while its wet
cyclic:membrane.guide: Becomes wet similar to farmland while it is touching water.  Walking across the wet version will provide a brief speed and jump boost
cyclic:cloud.guide: Whenever passing through, applies short slowness buff and removes current built up pending fall damage
cyclic:cloud_membrane.tooltip: Solid for anything not a player
cyclic:cloud_membrane.guide: Solid for most mobs, but players can pass through like air
cyclic:soil.tooltip: Keeps nearby Farmland damp without any water
cyclic:soil.guide: Nearby farmland treats this just like water, and will become and stay damp
cyclic:sound_player.tooltip: Plays sounds recorded on Sound Cards
cyclic:sound_player.guide: Play any sound recorded onto a Sound Data Card
cyclic:shape_data.state: Empty block, select one with a click first
cyclic:shape_data.nothing: Card requires a shape and a selected block
cyclic:settings_data.guide: Copy settings between cyclic machines.  Hit on bedrock to wipe data clean.  After data is copied, can only be put onto blocks with the same id.
cyclic:terra_preta.tooltip: Place below farmland for sprinkler-like growth
cyclic:terra_preta.guide: Place Terra Preta below farmland to increase the speed at which crops grow.  Works just like a sprinkler except there are no particles, and it only targets the block above.
cyclic:crate.tooltip: Reinforced and keeps contents when broken
cyclic:crate.guide: The Crate is a container, like a chest, that is reinforced to survive explosions and wither attacks.
cyclic:crate_mini.guide: The Crate is a container, like a chest, that is reinforced to survive explosions.  Can be waterlogged
cyclic:dark_glass.tooltip: Immune to light, explosions, and wither blasts
cyclic:dark_glass.guide: Dark Glass, unlike regular glass, does not let light pass through.Oh, and it's also immune explosions, including those caused by the Wither.  See connected version
cyclic:dark_glass_connected.tooltip: Immune to light, explosions, and wither blasts
cyclic:dark_glass_connected.guide: Self-connecting textures. Unlike regular glass, does not let light pass through.Oh, and it's also immune explosions, including those caused by the Wither.
cyclic:light_camo.tooltip: Sneak-left-click anything to make it render a facade block
cyclic:light_camo.guide: Produces light, and copies a block appearance.
cyclic:soundproofing_ghost.guide: Sneak-left-click anything to make it render a facade block
cyclic:soundproofing_ghost.tooltip: Use block on it to copy appearance.  Works exactly the same as regular soundproofing
cyclic:soundproofing.guide: Place to reduce the volume of nearby sounds in the world.  Multiple blocks stack together, and can be placed in close proximity for a stronger effect.  Break block or use redstone power to disable.  Config file has a setting for the radius.
cyclic:fan.guide: The Fan is a configurable machine designed to push players, mobs, items and other entities.Right-click on a fan to configure its range and speed.
cyclic:fan_slab.guide: The Fan Slab is a simple block machine designed to push players, mobs, items and other entities.
cyclic:peace_candle.guide: Prevents natural hostile mob spawns in a large radius including above and below (see config for values).  Interact to light or disable.
cyclic:water_candle.guide: The Water Candle can be lit by a player to increase the rate at which mobs naturally spawn nearby.For the candle to work, mobs must be able to spawn naturally in its vicinity.In most cases, this means it must be dark enough to spawn mobs!
cyclic:water_candle.guide0: When lit, has a random chance to extinguish itself while spawning a mob. When this happens, you must relight the candle for it to continue spawning.
cyclic:unbreakable_block.tooltip: Right-click with Redstone to toggle Unbreakable state
cyclic:unbreakable_block.guide: Place in the world and then right-click with Redstone dust, Redstone Torch, or a Redstone Block in hand to toggle whether this block can be broken.
cyclic:unbreakable_reactive.tooltip: Unbreakable while it has redstone power, can mine it otherwise
cyclic:unbreakable_reactive.guide: By default this can be mined as normal.  If it ever has a redstone signal given to it, then it becomes unbreakable by the block state. Unlike the other unbreakable block, this one uses a Tile Entity.
cyclic:conveyor.tooltip: Set speed with redstone torch, rotation type with wrench, color with dye
cyclic:conveyor.guide: Moves all entities standing on it.   Many properties of this block are stored in the blockstate such as type, speed, and dye color.  Types include straight, corner, and up/down ramps.  To toggle the type, place in world and use the Wooden Wrench on the placed rail, this toggles the type.
cyclic:conveyor.guide0: Hold a redstone torch and interact to toggle the speed.   Hold dye and use it on the block to toggle the color.  These updates propogate to nearby connected rails.  (check F3 to view these properties in detail)
cyclic:ender_item_shelf.guide: Stores 5 slots items.  Use any normal Wrench to toggle display mode, or a Rotation Tool to rotate its facing direction
cyclic:ender_shelf.guide: Stores 5 stacks of enchanted books. This also counts as a bookshelf for Enchanting tables. A Each shelf accepts books with exactly 1 enchantment on them, slots that you can right click on to insert or withdraw a Enchanted Book from storage.  Use any normal Wrench to toggle display mode, or a Rotation Tool to rotate its facing direction
cyclic:ender_shelf.guide0: Enchanted Books must have just one enchantment to be inserted. Use a Disenchanter to strip books down to single enchantments if necessary. Use mixed books on the Controller.
cyclic:ender_controller.guide: When combined with at least one Ender Shelf, allows for automated insertion/extraction of Enchanted books. Can accept mixed Enchanted Books
cyclic:workbench.tooltip: A Crafting Table that keeps its inventory when closed
cyclic:workbench.guide: A simple Crafting Table that keeps its inventory when closed.
cyclic:flippers.guide: When worn, Flippers increase the player's swim speed.Can be equipped as an accessory if the Curios mod is installed.
cyclic:glove_climb.guide: When worn, Climbing Gloves allow the player to climb vertical surfaces as if a ladder or vines were present.Can be equipped as an accessory if the Curios mod is installed.
cyclic:breaker.tooltip: Breaks blocks placed in front of it
cyclic:breaker.guide: Breakers can be used to break the block placed directly in front of it, like a player would.Breakers do not have internal item storage, so the broken block will drop itself (or its loot) in the world to be picked up.
cyclic:rotation_wand.guide: Its not really a wrench, see the data tags.  This sipmle tool can be used to rotate simple blocks such as stairs, slabs, and similar compatible blocks that face certain directions.  Try hitting blocks from different angles
cyclic:cable_wrench.tooltip: Use to make cables extract, crouch and use to block cables
cyclic:cable_wrench.guide: Use this cable Wrench by right-clicking on a Cyclic cable to change the cable's settings such as import filter, blocked, normal.  Blocked state only appears while player is sneaking/crouching.  Works on compatible blocks using the forge:tools/wrench data tag
cyclic:build_scepter.guide: The Building Scepter is a powerful tool that comes in three forms - Fill, Place, and Exchange.For each, left clicking on any block will change the size of the area that will be affected. Sneak-left-clicking will select the block to be placed by the scepter. Right-click with the scepter to place or exchange blocks from your inventory.
cyclic:build_scepter.guide0: $(li)The Fill Scepter places blocks in the specified-shape around the block you right-click on.$(li)The Exchange Scepter swaps all blocks with your selected block in a shape around the block you right-click.$(li)The Place Scepter is similar to the Fill Scepter, except the blocks are placed on the surface of the block you right-click.
cyclic:randomize_scepter.tooltip: Randomly shuffle around the blocks in a 5x5x1 area around the target block
cyclic:randomize_scepter.guide: Randomly shuffle around the blocks in a 5x5x1 area around the target block
cyclic:ender_book.guide: A magical book that stores your current location as a waypoint.   Crouch and scroll to pick location.  Crouch and use to teleport.  Jump to cancel the port.  Repair with energy or ender pearls
cyclic:ender_book.tooltip: Crouch to teleport or scroll through locations
cantoggle:guide: Right click this item in your inventory to toggle it on or off.
iscurios:guide: If the Curios mod is installed, this item can be worn as an accessory.
cyclic:carbon_paper.tooltip: Copy sign contents, clean on a cauldron
cyclic:carbon_paper.guide: Carbon Paper can be used to copy the contents of one sign to another. The copied text can be cleaned off of the Carbon Paper by using it on a Cauldron.
cyclic:antigravity.tooltip: Ignore gravity and walk on air
cyclic:antigravity.guide: When active, you can jump without falling at the expense of durability while you remain in the air.
cyclic:charm_antidote.guide: When in your inventory or worn as an accessory, protects you from poison at the expense of durability.
cyclic:charm_wither.guide: When in your inventory or worn as an accessory, protects you from the Wither status effect at the expense of durability.
cyclic:charm_ultimate.tooltip: Poison, wither, fire, lava, and void protection
cyclic:charm_ultimate.guide: When in your inventory or worn as an accessory, combines the protection effects of the Antidote Charm, Wither Charm, Fire Charm, and Void Charm.
charm_boat:guide: Increases your rowing speed in a boat.  Right click in your inventory to turn it off.  Compatible with baubles API.
cyclic:charm_fire.guide: When in your inventory or worn as an accessory, protects you from fire damage at the expense of durability.
cyclic:charm_speed.guide: Gives you a passive speed boost, can be stacked with speed potions.  Default is 50 percent boost, depends on config file.  Right click in your inventory to turn it off.
cyclic:charm_void.guide: Works in your inventory or in a Baubles slot.  This charm saves you from the void; it detects if you have fallen down below y=-30 and teleports you way up into the sky instead.
cyclic:charm_void.tooltip: Saves you from falling into the void
charm_water:guide: This gives you water breathing effect if it finds you running out of air.  Right click in your inventory to turn it off.  Compatible with baubles API.
cyclic:charm_wing.guide: Protects you from falling long distances.  If this is on when you fall more than six blocks, it gives you a short burst of the Slowfall potion effect, which is just like a parachute.  Right click in your inventory to turn it off.
cyclic:charm_wing.tooltip: Grants slowfall after falling far enough
cyclic:tile_transporter.guide: Right click on any machine or container with the Sack of Holding to pick it up.Right click on any block with a filled Sack of Holding to place the machine again.
cyclic:tile_transporter_empty.tooltip: Transport a container with its contents
crafting_food:guide: Unlock a permanent 3x3 crafting table inside your inventory.  Once unlocked, you can open it with a keybinding or with a button in your inventory.
cyclic_wand:shifting: Use the mouse wheel while sneaking to rotate
cyclic_wand:guide: Advanced long range building tool.  Has a custom HUD to change the direction (sneak and mouse wheel) Fill its inventory with blocks to build with.  Has different building modes: Random, Pattern, and Normal.
dropper_minecart:guide: Its inventory is the same as a Dropper.  Use an activator rail to make it drop one of its items.
dropper_minecart:tooltip: Drops an item when it hits an activator rail
dynamite_mining:guide: This creates a powerful explosion that does not hurt players or mobs.  It does break blocks, but unlike regular explosions no blocks are lost, so it acts like mining.
dynamite_mining:tooltip: Drops 100% of blocks broken as items.  Does not hurt anything living.
dynamite_safe:guide: This creates a powerful explosion that does not destroy blocks or hurt creatures.
dynamite_safe:tooltip: Does not break blocks or hurt players
cyclic:emerald_gear.guide: Equipment and armor made from Emeralds. Stronger than diamond equipment.
cyclic:ender_eye_reuse.tooltip: Reuseable ender eye for finding strongholds
cyclic:ender_eye_reuse.guide: Reuseable Ender Eye for finding strongholds. Can be thrown multiple times and will not break.
cyclic:fire_scepter.tooltip: Magic wand with a triple fire shot
cyclic:fire_scepter.guide: Launch three projectiles that burn and damage entities.  Does not set fire to the world.
cyclic:spawner_seeker.guide: The Spawner Seeker can be used to find the nearest spawner to your current location.
cyclic:ender_fishing.tooltip: Throw in the water to fish
cyclic:ender_fishing.guide: When time this lands in water it tries to catch a fish from current loot tables.  One consumed on each throw.  Ignores the treasure loot tables, so only junk and fish.
cyclic:lightning_scepter.guide: Launch a projectile that will spawn a natural lightning bolt when it lands.
cyclic:ender_pearl_mounted.tooltip: Reuseable ender pearl that carries you
cyclic:ender_pearl_mounted.guide: An enhanced Ender Pearl that also carries the user when thrown.
cyclic:ender_pearl_reuse.guide: An Ender Pearl that can be thrown, picked up, and thrown again.
cyclic:ice_scepter.tooltip: Shoot ice that will stun enemies
cyclic:ice_scepter.guide: Launch three frozen projectiles that applies the paralyze potion effect to all enemies
cyclic:ender_tnt_1.guide: Throw these to make explosions.  There are six different levels of power.  These are standard normal explosions with no special properties.
cyclic:ender_tnt_4.guide: 1/3 power of charged creeper; Same strength as TNT
cyclic:ender_tnt_4.tooltip: 1/3 power of charged creeper; Same strength as TNT
cyclic:ender_tnt_6.guide: Same power as charged creeper; Same strength as Ender Crystal
cyclic:ender_tnt_6.tooltip: Same power as charged creeper; Same strength as Ender Crystal
cyclic:ender_torch.guide: A throwable torch.  This places a torch in the world wherever it lands.
cyclic:ender_water.guide: Vaporize nearby liquid, three modes of water, lava, generic liquid
cyclic:ender_wool.guide: Throw a bunch of these at a herd of sheeep to shear them all at a distance.  Gives a slight bonus to wool drops compared to regular shears.
cyclic:evoker_fang.tooltip: Summons the secret magic of the Evoker Illager
cyclic:evoker_fang.guide: Summons a beam of Evoker Fangs in whatever direction youre facing.  Must be used on an entity or a block.
cyclic:fire_dark.guide: Does not burn players or destroy blocks.
cyclic:fire_killer.guide: Extinguish all nearby fire based on the fire data tag.
cyclic:apple_lofty_stature.guide: Eating increases your step height to a full block like a horse (eat again to undo)
cyclic:apple_lofty_stature.tooltip: Eating increases your step height to a full block like a horse (eat again to undo)
cyclic:chorus_flight.guide: A balanced way to get the power of flight.  Gives you a few (stackable) minutes of creative flight each time its eaten.  Use milk to remove.
cyclic:chorus_spectral.guide: Eat this to phase through walls for a few seconds. Does not include flight, you will fall into the void without extra items or abilities, and you can get stuck inside a wall
cyclic:glowing_helmet.guide: Enables glowing night vision while worn, you can also turn it on and off by right-clicking (works in most inventory screens)
cyclic:heart.guide: When consumed, grants the player 1 permanent, extra heart. Multiple can be consumed for additional hearts.  Config file specifies the maximum number of hearts allowed, default is 20.
cyclic:heart_empty.guide: When consumed, permanently removes 1 heart from the player but grants a hefty dose of experience for your loss.Be careful! You can reduce your hearts permanently down to just one if you keep eating these.
cyclic:apple_chocolate.guide: Similar to milk, when eaten it clears out potion effects.  However it only removes harmful ones like poison, and not beneficial ones such as regeneration or night vision.
cyclic:apple_honey.guide: Rich food that has no effects.  Used for crafting.
cyclic:apple_ender.guide: Eat will show the names a few nearby structures, and their horizontal straight-line distance to your position
cyclic:apple_diamond.guide: 60 seconds worth of Resistance V and health boost V for short tough fights.  Must be grown and harvested from a sprout
cyclic:apple_lapis.guide: Utility buffs include swim speed, conduit, water breathing, night vision.
cyclic:apple_iron.guide: Lower levels of health boost and resistance
cyclic:apple_emerald.guide: Exlorative buffs include haste, luck, slow falling.  Must be grown and harvested from a sprout
cyclic:carrot_ender.guide: Give your horse some magic shields.  These trigger when the mount is drowning, falling, burning, or low on health.  When triggered, it will consume one tick of the count and buff the mount accordingly.
cyclic:toxic_carrot.guide: Use the Toxic Carrot on a horse to turn it into a Zombie Horse.
cyclic:diamond_carrot_health.guide: Use the Diamond Carrot on a horse to increase its max health.Multiple can be used to increase the horse's max health even more.
cyclic:redstone_carrot_speed.guide: Use the Redstone Carrot on a horse to increase its top sped.Multiple can be used to increase the top speed even more.
cyclic:emerald_carrot_jump.guide: Use the Emerald Carrot on a horse to increase its jump height.Multiple can be used to increase the jump height even more.
cyclic:lapis_carrot_variant.guide: Use the Lapis Carrot on a horse to change its coat to a different variant.Keep using additional Lapis Carrots until you find the coat you're looking for.
cyclic:inventory_cake.guide: Eating this will unlock a second inventory screen.
cyclic:inventory_cake.tooltip: Eat to gain a permanent magical backpack
cyclic:magic_net.tooltip: Charge and throw at a living entity to capture
cyclic:magic_net.guide: The Monster Ball can be thrown at a creature to capture it. The creature will remain in the ball until you right-click a block with the Monster Ball in hand to release it.An easier alternative to transporting mobs with leashes or minecarts.
cyclic:mob_container.tooltip: Spawn captured mob from a Monster Ball
cyclic:mattock_stone.tooltip: 3x3 mining; equal parts shovel and pickaxe
cyclic:mattock_stone.guide: The Mattock combines the mining capability of a pickaxe with a shovel in a 3x3 pattern that treats dirt and stone type blocks equally.
cyclic:mattock.tooltip: 3x3 mining; equal parts shovel and pickaxe
cyclic:mattock.guide: The Mattock combines the mining capability of a pickaxe with a shovel in a 3x3 pattern that treats dirt and stone type blocks equally.
cyclic:mattock_nether.tooltip: 5x3 mining; equal parts shovel and pickaxe
cyclic:mattock_nether.guide: The Mattock combines the mining capability of a pickaxe with a shovel in a 5x3 pattern that treats dirt and stone type blocks equally.
cyclic:lever_remote.tooltip: Bind this to a lever in the world (shift click) to activate it remotely
cyclic:lever_remote.guide: Remote redstone lever that you bind to a lever in the world by sneaking.  Works across any distance including dimensions if the chunk is loaded.
cyclic:crystal_gear.guide: Crystallized Obsidian gear is very strong (and very expensive as a result). Much stronger than Netherite gear.
cyclic:ender_bag.guide: The Ender Bag provides a portable interface to your Ender Chest. Anything you store in your Ender Chest inventory can be accessed via the Ender Bag, and vice versa.
cyclic:sandstone_gear.guide: The sandstone tools are slightly below stone quality but better than wood.
cyclic:sandstone_gear.title: Sandstone Gear
cyclic:sleeping_mat.guide: Use this to make yourself start sleeping right where you stand.  Potion results can be toggled in config. Does not change your respawn point.
cyclic:soulstone.guide: Triggers the Totem of Undying revival ritual.  Does not have to be held or in your hotbar, just your inventory.  Breaks when durability runs out
cyclic:soulstone.tooltip: Concentrated essense from Totem of Undying
cyclic:sprout_seed.guide: Grow a magical plant that gives a random junk or treasure when harvested.
cyclic:sprout_seed.tooltip: Grow to harvest random junk and treasure
cyclic:stone_minecart.guide: Think of this as a single-slot chest.  The Stone Minecart can carry any block.  Just use another block or an empty hand to swap blocks in an out (also works with Automated User).  Powered activator rail will pop the block out as well.
cyclic:stone_minecart.tooltip: Carry one block, unload with activator rail
cyclic:storage_bag.guide: The Storage Bag can be used as a portable inventory. Right-click with the bag in hand to open it. The bag can be set to pickup items, refill your hotbar, or to deposit its items into any inventory on right-click.
cyclic:storage_bag.guide0: To change the color of your bag, first open it, pickup some Dye with your mouse, and place it on top of the bag.  This will not consume the dye or move the bag, but it will set the bag item color.
cyclic:sword_ender.guide: Unbreakable sword with a special right-click ability to launch an ender pearl
cyclic:sword_slowness.tooltip: Blocking shoots a slowness splash potion
cyclic:sword_slowness.guide: Unbreakable sword with a special right-click ability to launch a slowness potion
cyclic:sword_weakness.tooltip: Blocking shoots a weakness splash potion
cyclic:sword_weakness.guide: Unbreakable sword with a special right-click ability to launch a weakness potion
cyclic:charm_torch.tooltip: Torches the darkness at your feet while in your inventory
cyclic:charm_torch.guide: Whenever this detects darkness at your feet, it places a torch there and drains some durability.  Right click in your inventory to turn it off.
cyclic:charm_torch_cave.tooltip: Torches your dark surroundings while in your inventory
cyclic:charm_torch_cave.guide: Detects darkness in an area around you and places torches where necessary, draining some durability.  Right click in your inventory to turn it off.
cyclic:scythe_forage.tooltip: Forage growing resources based on data tag
cyclic:scythe_forage.guide: Forage growing resources, using the following block data tags:  minecraft:flowers, minecraft:corals, forge:mushrooms, forge:vines, forge:cactus, forge:crop_blocks
cyclic:scythe_leaves.guide: Harvests all nearby leaves on use, using the minecraft:leaves block data tag
cyclic:scythe_brush.tooltip: Harvest weeds based on data tag.
cyclic:scythe_brush.guide: Harvest everything under the block data tag forge:plants.
tool_launcher:tooltip: Hold and use to launch yourself in the selected direction
tool_launcher:guide: Aim and then charge this up like a bow and then release it to get launched into the air.  It has two modes, forward and reverse, that you can toggle with attack (left-click).  Forward means you need to aim up into the air, and you fly the exact direction and angle that you look.  Reverse means you have to aim down at the ground and you get launched backwards.  Using this gives you the "bouncy" potion effect, which makes anything you land on bounce you up like a slime block.
tool_mount:guide: Mount any entity that is not normally mountable.
cyclic:stirrups.tooltip: Mount any entity (without the control of the saddle)
cyclic:stirrups.guide: Mount any entity (without the control of the saddle)
cyclic:stirrups_reverse.guide: Pickup target entity on top of you.  Use it on the mob again to put down
cyclic:mount_inverse.tooltip: Pickup a living entity and mount it on your head.
cyclic:mount_inverse.guide: Pickup a living entity and mount it on your head.
cyclic:prospector.guide: Searches out for ores behind the block you click on.  Uses the forge:ores block tag
cyclic:push.guide: This tool has three modes: Push, Pull, Rotate.  Change mode using attack (Left-Click).  Push and pull work similar to a piston, moving the block as long as there is an air block where it is moving; and it also moves tile entities with their data (full chests/furnaces/etc).  Rotate mode will try to spin the block around on its axis, such as log positioning, or halfslabs and stairs moving to alternate orientations.
cyclic:randomize.guide: This will mixup the blocks in the nearby area, to help you vary the texture of your wall or pathway.  Use the attack (Left-Click) to change size.  It affects a flat area along the face of whatever you hit.  Tile entities are ignored (chests and so on).
cyclic:randomize.tooltip: Randomize selected blocks.  Left click to resize.
cyclic:rotate.guide: Attempts to rotate the targeted block while respecting the same material type.  So it will turn a log to a different angle, but will not turn oak planks into spruce planks.  This can be used to get vanilla only blocks that are otherwise un-obainable blocks, like smooth stone double slabs with the flat side, extra smooth sandstone, and a log with bark on all six sides.
cyclic:rotate.tooltip: Rotates simple blocks/machines if they are able
cyclic:spawn_inspector.guide: Tells you exactly which mobs can spawn on the targeted block.  Natural spawns only, ignores mob spawner blocks.  Useful for making slime, witch, and wither skeleton farms.
cyclic:spawn_inspector.tooltip: Detects mob spawns (including modded, slimes, and Wither skeletons)
cyclic:spawn_inspector.up: Click on the top side of a block
cyclic:spelunker.guide: Searches out for empty space behind the block you click on.  Works in any direction.  If you hit the top of a block it searches down, if you hit the side it searches behind.  Always in a straight line.  Great for finding caves while branch mining.
cyclic:torch_launcher.tooltip: Spawns in a torch wherever it lands
cyclic:torch_launcher.guide: The Torch Launcher shoots a torch with considerable force in the direction you are facing, placing the torch wherever it lands.Automatically consumes torches in your inventory to refill itself.
cyclic:trade.tooltip: Opens an improved trading interface with the closest villager
cyclic:trade.guide: Use near a villager for an advanced trading menu.  Has convenience buttons that perform one trade with each click.  Fully respects all villager trading rules, mechanics, locks, and unlocks.
cyclic:charm_home.tooltip: Teleport to your personal spawn point
cyclic:charm_home.guide: Warps you back home at cost of durability. If you have an active Respawn Anchor in the Nether and you are currently in the Nether, you will be teleported there.Otherwise, you will be teleported to your bed if you are in the Overworld and you have slept in a bed to set your respawn point.
cyclic:charm_world.guide: Warps you to world spawn at the cost of durability.
cyclic:wand_hypno.guide: Confuse nearby hostiles so they attack each other
cyclic:wand_hypno.tooltip: Confuse nearby hostiles so they attack each other
cyclic:wand_missile.guide: Spawns homing missiles at nearby hostile targets
cyclic:wand_missile.tooltip: Spawns homing missiles at nearby hostile targets
cyclic:spell_ice.guide: Turns nearby water blocks into ice.  Costs durability to use.
cyclic:spell_water.tooltip: Replace nearby flowing water with source water
cyclic:spell_water.guide: Turns nearby flowing water into source water.  Fills lakes and rivers out very quickly.
cyclic:teleport_wand.tooltip: Teleports where you look, using Ender Pearls as fuel
cyclic:teleport_wand.guide: The Ender Scepter when held and charged, can be used to teleport large distances to the block that you're looking at. Automatically consumes Ender Pearls in your inventory to repair itself.
cyclic:elevation_wand.tooltip: Teleport yourself or the target entity up to the nearest surface above
cyclic:elevation_wand.guide: Teleporter that works only vertically, and only if it can find an empty space with a surface above.  Works on yourself, or target another entity.
cyclic:antimatter_wand.guide: Left-click to cycle between Water, Lava, and Generic Fluid modes. Right-click to clear a 9x9 area of the selected fluid type from the world.
cyclic:crafter.guide: Set the recipe, and this will autocraft as many as it can.  Input slots are on the left slots, outputs on the right.  Also works with pipes/cables/hoppers for input and output
cyclic:beacon.tooltip: Use potions to generate beacon effects
cyclic:beacon.guide: The Pharos Beacon takes power and potions as input and automatically applies potion effects to the selected type of entity in a radius around itself. Can target players, mobs, animals, etc. If Entity data card is present, it is also applied along with the button filter together.
cyclic:anti_beacon.tooltip: Cures most harmful potion effects nearby
cyclic:anti_beacon.guide: Nearby potions get cleared every few ticks, and on placement.  Many settings for this are in the config file.
cyclic:beacon_redstone.guide: Displays a beacon beam when powered with redstone.  No potion effects of any kind
cyclic:beacon_redstone.tooltip: Displays a beacon beam when powered with redstone
cyclic:disenchanter.guide: The Disenchanter can take an enchantment off of an item and apply it to a book. Only one enchantment is stripped at a time, so items with multiple enchantments will need to be disenchanted multiple times.
cyclic:anvil.guide: The Powered Diamond Anvil repairs equipment using Energy
cyclic:anvil_magma.guide: The Magma Anvil repairs equipment using liquid Magma.  Pipe it in from a tank or something else
cyclic:enchanter.tooltip: Add enchantments using experience fluid and energy
cyclic:enchanter.guide: Feed in experience as a fluid, and then add any enchantable item. Can be automated with pipes & hoppers.
cyclic:fisher.tooltip: Fishes in nearby water using a fishing rod
cyclic:fisher.guide: Place in water and give it a fishing rod and it will automatically catch fish.Caught fish will be dropped in the world and need to be picked up manually or by other machines.
cyclic:scaffold.guide.title: Scaffolding
cyclic:scaffold.guide: Scaffolding is a cheap, easy to break block that can be used when building. All Scaffolding can be placed in mid-air and climbed like a ladder.
cyclic:scaffold_fragile.tooltip: Angel placement in mid-air; Decays over time
cyclic:scaffold_responsive.tooltip: Angel placement in mid-air; Breaks itself all in a line when you break the adjacent one
cyclic:scaffold_responsive.guide: Breaks itself all in a line when you break the adjacent one.
cyclic:scaffold_replace.tooltip: Angel placement in mid-air; Use a block on this to replace it
cyclic:scaffold_replace.guide: Use a block on this to replace it.
cyclic:tank.tooltip: Stores up to 64 buckets of any liquid
cyclic:tank.guide: The Fluid Storage Tank is the big brother of the Cask, able to store more fluid in a single block.
cyclic:user.tooltip: Autonomous right-click activation using any item
cyclic:user.guide: The Item User is a powerful machine that uses the item given to it to right click the block in front of it with a configurable delay.
cyclic:screen.guide: Like a slightly advanced computerized sign, used to project text into the world.Projected text may extend beyond the edges of the screen.
cyclic:screen_target.tooltip: Display properties of a distant block
cyclic:screen_target.guide: Target a block with a GPS marker, and you can display its fluid, energy, or item content
cyclic:library_ctrl.tooltip: Surround this with Ender Bookshelves to deposit
cyclic:library_ctrl.guide: The controller block for Ender Bookshelves.  Surround it with Ender Bookshelves so it can connect and it will distribute enchantments.  Can be automated by piping in enchanted books and pulling out empty books.
cyclic:library.tooltip: Four drawers of deep enchantment storage
cyclic:library.guide: Use enchanted books on any corner.  Each corner stores many copies of that same enchantment.  Use a book on it to withdraw.  Hold a Redstone Torch in your hand and hit it to toggle display modes.
cyclic:structure.guide: This advanced building machine has a fixed set of shapes such as Pyramid, Sphere, Cylander, etc.  Using power and blocks you can build any shape with this.  Also can use Shape Data Cards for custom shapes.
builder_pattern:flip: Flip Regions (purple is source, white is target)
builder_pattern:guide: This advanced building machine can copy almost anything.  Select two nearby regions of the world of equal size and shape, give it materials, and it will copy the build from one area to the other.
builder_pattern:tooltip: Copy and paste the selected area using supplied materials
cyclic:clock.tooltip: Clock with time and power controls
cyclic:clock.guide: The Redstone Clock emits a redstone signal with a configurable delay, length, and signal.Useful for contraptions that need to work on a timer.
cyclic:detector_entity.tooltip: Detect entities nearby and output redstone
cyclic:detector_entity.guide: Detect entities nearby and outputs a redstone signal when detected. The detection range, type of entity, amount, and comparison type are configurable from its GUI.
cyclic:detector_item.tooltip: Detect items nearby and output redstone
cyclic:detector_item.guide: Detect items nearby and outputs a redstone signal. The range and comparison method are configurable in its GUI.
cyclic:fire_dark.tooltip: Does not harm players or destroy blocks
cyclic:harvester.guide: The Harvester will gently farm crops in an area in front of it, replanting the seeds (if any) after breaking the crop.
cyclic:magnet_anti_block.guide: This repels hostile entities away from it every few ticks.
cyclic:magnet_anti_block.tooltip: Repels mobs every $t$ ticks with range $r$
cyclic:magnet_block.guide: Attracts nearby items on the ground.  Interact to toggle on and off.  Intended to help with early game automation
cyclic:password_block.activetype.tooltip: Switch between On/Off and Pulse mode
cyclic:password_block.guide: Use this to trigger a redstone signal or pulse from far away.  It triggers when the password you set is seen in chat, at which point the chat display is cancelled.  You can also claim ownership to prevent the password working for other players.
cyclic:password_block.triggered: Password Block triggered; chat message cancelled:
cyclic:password_block.triggeredmany: Password Blocks triggered; chat message cancelled:
cyclic:password_block.userclaim.tooltip: Only the owner of the block can change the password
cyclic:password_block.usersallowed.toolt: Who can active this block with the password
cyclic:placer.guide: Places a block from its inventory in the direction it is facing.
cyclic:plate_launch.guide: The Bounce Plate Launches any entity that touches it into the air.
cyclic:plate_launch_redstone.tooltip: Launch entities based on redstone power value
cyclic:plate_launch_redstone.guide: The Bounce Plate Launches any entity that touches it into the air with magnitude that increases as the provided redstone signal increases.
cyclic:plate_vector.guide: This is a combination of a jump pad and a conveyor, you can configure its strength and angle in the GUI.  Once configured, it saves data into the item, and you can tap it on any other plate to copy the configration into it.
cyclic:plate_vector.tooltip.button: Yaw is the horizontal aim, Pitch is the vertical aim, and Strength affects the distance
cyclic:spikes.guide: Spikes can be placed in the world in any orientation to damage creatures or players that touch them. Spikes are only extended when they receive a redstone signal.
cyclic:spikes_iron.tooltip: Powered by redstone; damage on contact
cyclic:spikes_fire.tooltip: Powered by redstone; burns on contact
cyclic:spikes_curse.tooltip: Powered by redstone; curses on contact
cyclic:spikes_curse.guide: Curses enemies with various negative effects on contact.
cyclic:spikes_diamond.tooltip: Powered by redstone; damage on contact
cyclic:spikes_diamond.guide: Damage entities on contact.  Attacks using a fake player to trigger loot tables
cyclic:sprinkler.guide: This only runs while water is inside the internal tank (fill with a bucket or pipes).  It will water nearby crops, increasing their growing speed.  Consumes water source blocks from below.  Multiple sprinklers in the same area do stack.
cyclic:sprinkler.tooltip: Consumes water and grows nearby crops
cyclic:sprout.guide: When this is harvested it randomly drops a block from a custom loot table (listed in config file)
cyclic:uncrafter.notenoughitems: Not enough items to satisfy recipe
cyclic:uncrafter.guide: This will lookup and reverse any vanilla 2x2 or 3x3 recipe.  May not work with specialized modded recipes / machine recipes.
cyclic:wireless_redstone.guide.title: Wireless Redstone
cyclic:wireless_redstone.guide: The Wireless Redstone Transmitter and Receiver allow you to transmit redstone signals between distant points.Place a Wireless Receiver in the world and use a GPS Marker on it to store its coordinates. Then insert the GPS Marker into a Redstone Transmitter.Anytime the Transmitter receives a redstone signal, it will cause all linked Receivers to receive the same signal.
cyclic:wireless_transmitter.tooltip: Transmit wireless redstone to any compatible block
cyclic:wireless_transmitter.guide: The Wireless Redstone Transmitter and Receiver allow you to transmit redstone signals between distant points.Place a Wireless Receiver in the world and use a GPS Marker on it to store its coordinates. Then insert the GPS Marker into a Redstone Transmitter.Anytime the Transmitter receives a redstone signal, it will cause all linked Receivers to receive the same signal.
cyclic:wireless_receiver.guide: The Wireless Redstone Transmitter and Receiver allow you to transmit redstone signals between distant points.Place a Wireless Receiver in the world and use a GPS Marker on it to store its coordinates. Then insert the GPS Marker into a Redstone Transmitter.Anytime the Transmitter receives a redstone signal, it will cause all linked Receivers to receive the same signal.
cyclic:wireless_receiver.tooltip: Receive wireless redstone signals from a Transmitter
cyclic:tile_transporter_empty.guide: Right click on any machine or container with the Sack of Holding to pick it up.  Right click on any block with a filled Sack of Holding to place the machine again.
minecraft:potion.effect.cyclic_haste.gui: The Potion of Haste apples the Haste effect to the target, increasing their mining speed.
minecraft:potion.effect.cyclic_swimspeed: The Potion of Swim Speed greatly increases its target's speed while moving through liquids.
minecraft:potion.effect.cyclic_stun.guid: The Potion of Paralyze completely immobilizes its target.
cyclic:placer_fluid.guide: The Fluid Placer places fluid from its internal tank in the direction it is facing, if possible.
cyclic:pipe.guide.title: Cables
cyclic:pipe.guide: Types of cables can be used to transport fluids, items, or energy between machines. They can be configured using a Cable Wrench.
cyclic:fluid_pipe.tooltip: Pipe liquid between blocks; use a Cable Wrench to customize
cyclic:fluid_pipe.tooltip0: Also collects fluid source blocks from the world
cyclic:fluid_pipe.guide: Pipe liquid between blocks.  Has extraction mode with a filter GUI, and a yellow blocked state to disable the flow.  Also collects fluid from the world.  Shift-left-click to set and remove blocks to cover the pipe as a Facade
cyclic:energy_pipe.tooltip: Pipe energy between blocks; use a Cable Wrench to customize
cyclic:energy_pipe.guide: Pipe energy between blocks.  Has extraction mode with a filter GUI, and a yellow blocked state to disable the flow.  Shift-left-click to set and remove blocks to cover the pipe as a Facade
cyclic:item_pipe.tooltip: Pipe items between blocks; use a Cable Wrench to customize
cyclic:item_pipe.guide: Pipe items between blocks.  Has extraction mode with a filter GUI, and a yellow blocked state to disable the flow.  Shift-left-click to set and remove blocks to cover the pipe as a Facade
cyclic:item_pipe_sort.tooltip: Sorting machine for use with cables and hoppers
cyclic:item_pipe_sort.filter: Output here only if it matches this filter
cyclic:item_pipe_sort.everything: Output everything here, ignoring this filter
cyclic:item_pipe_sort.nothing: Output nothing here, ignoring this filter
cyclic:biomass.guide: Combine with various organic material in a Melter to create Fluid Biomass
cyclic:peat_fuel.tooltip: Smelted peat.  Use in a generator.
cyclic:peat_fuel.guide: Peat Fuel is smelted from Saturated Peat Deposits and used in a Generator to generate energy.It can also be combined with  Fluid Biomass in a Solidification Chamber to create Enriched Peat.
cyclic:peat_fuel_enriched.guide: Created by combining Peat with Fluid Biomass in a Solidification Chamber and used to provide even more power in a Generator.
cyclic:peat_unbaked.tooltip: Slowly turns into a Peat Deposit when sitting in water
cyclic:peat_unbaked.guide: Dry Peat Bog, when placed next to water, will slowly turn into a Saturated Peat Deposit, which can be smelted to create fuel for the Generator.
cyclic:peat_baked.tooltip: Wet peat ready to be harvested and smelted
cyclic:peat_baked.guide: Saturated Peat Deposits form over time when Dry Peat Bog is placed next to water. Once harvested, it can be smelted to create fuel for the Generator.
cyclic:generator_fuel.tooltip: Generate power from anything that burns as fuel in Furnaces
cyclic:generator_fuel.guide: Generate power from anything that burns as fuel in Furnaces.  Burn time is the same number of ticks as the furnace time, for example 1 coal = 1600 ticks.  Energy per ticks is in the config file, defaults to 80 RF/t
cyclic:generator_solar.guide: WHen these blocks can see they skylight during the day, they will generate small amounts of energy
cyclic:generator_food.tooltip: Generate power from anything that can be eaten
cyclic:generator_food.guide: Generate power from food type items.  Burn time and energy per tick are set up in the config file.  It uses both food and saturation values multiplied by a factor.  Energy speed defaults to 80 RF/t
cyclic:generator_item.tooltip: Breaks down matter to generate energy
cyclic:generator_item.guide: Generate power from certain mob drop items.  All energy producing recipes are set in the JSON datapack; for example a default recipe breaks down Ender Pearls for 100 RF/t
cyclic:generator_fluid.guide: Evaporate liquids to generate energy.  All recipes are defined in the JSON datapack; one of the default recipes produces lava at 80 RF/t.
cyclic:peat_farm.guide: The Peat Farm takes water and Dry Peat Bog as its inputs and automatically builds a 15x15 Peat Bog farm surrounding itself.When Dry Peat Bog becomes saturated, the Peat Farm will automatically harvest it and place more Dry Peat Bog in its place.
cyclic:miner.tooltip: Mines a configurable area in front of the Miner
cyclic:miner.guide: Mines a configurable area in front of the Miner. Will attempt to mine with any tool you provide it.  See Blockstate Data Card
cyclic:forester.guide: The Forester will attempt to place saplings in the area in front of itself, and harvest them when the saplings grow into trees.
cyclic:dropper.guide: Drops blocks from its internal buffer at a configurable stack size, distance, and delay.
cyclic:battery.guide: Stores Forge Energy (FE) to be used in machines. Power can be transferred to and from the battery via cables or by placing machines directly adjacent to the battery.
cyclic:item_infinite.guide: Duplicate items for pack testing.  Add an item with your hand or a hopper, then pull it out with another and it repeats itself including NBT and damage
fire_dark:guide: Does not destroy blocks or harm players.  Spawned by Duskflame Hex
target:tooltip: Emits redstone based on where the arrow lands
target:guide: Emits redstone based on where the arrow lands.  Only works on the side, not top or bottom.
moon_sensor:tooltip: Emits signal based on current moons phase
moon_sensor:guide: Emits signal based on current moons phase.  Power ranges along 1,3,5,7,9,11,13,15 and back down again.  Stays powered during the day, and changes every night as the moon shifts phases.
robot_spawner:tooltip: [EXPERIMENTAL FEATURE] Spawn a Target Dummy Spawner that measures damage done by a player
robot_spawner:guide: Spawn a Target Dummy Spawner that measures damage done by a player.  Can be given armor that will affect damage taken, and drop on death.  Has no movement or attacks.  Can be killed, or removed instantly by using the spawner on it again.
fire_starter:tooltip: Use flint to start a fire on signal
fire_starter:guide: Use flint to start a fire on redsotne signal.  Can face any direction.  Chance to consume flint.
fire_frost:tooltip: Low intermittent damage; slowness and weakness
fire_frost:guide: Low intermittent damage; slowness and weakness
cyclic:anvil_void.guide: Delete enchantments off anything by wiping out the enchantments NBT tag.  Uses no power
sound_player:guide: Can play almost any non-record sound on redstone signal.  Be careful playing music tracks over and over, they can will overlap.
sign_editor:tooltip: Edit sign text, colour, and font
sign_editor:guide: Edit sign text, color, and font.  Save data in the sign is fully vanilla compatible, same NBT tags as command blocks when they set colour.
cyclic:dice.guide: When placed or clicked, the Dice will roll and show a new random number from 1-6.
cyclic:laser_cannon.guide: Only fires when there is a living target.  Press and hold to shoot
cyclic:laser_cannon.notarget: No target found, firing process uninitiated
imbuer:tooltip: Imbue your bow with secret powers
imbuer:guide: Imbue your bow with secret powers.  Place in an ingredient and a bow, and then apply a redstone signal.  Sneak right-click while it is empty to list valid recipes.
cyclic:slingshot.guide: Charge like a bow.  Ammunition is built in, so it simply consumes durability.
cyclic:netherbrick_gear.guide.title: Nether Gear
cyclic:netherbrick_gear.guide: Nether gear is slightly stronger than Stone gear.
cyclic:packager.guide: Package matching items together.  Compatible with all 2x2, 3x3 recipes that are specifically merging identical items together such as Iron Blocks or Bricks
dehydrator:guide: Dehydrate certain items.  Add more recipes using CraftTweaker.  Lava is optional but will increase processing speed.
cyclic:shearing.tooltip: Shears sheep like mobs on contact
cyclic:shearing.guide: Shears sheep for wool when touched.  Block has no durability like the shears item.  Works on all compatible mobs, not only Sheep, using IForgeShearable
